detail.title: HDMI 2.0 Cable with Blue Metal Cap - 10 Meters
detail.overview: The Ant Esports AEH110 is a 10-metre HDMI 2.0 cable finished with a distinctive blue metal connector cap and 24K gold-plated contacts for reliable, corrosion-resistant connections over time. Rated for 18Gbps bandwidth, it supports the full range of HDTV resolutions and refresh rates for sharp, lag-free video and audio even across this longer run. Its sturdy build and premium connector finish make it a dependable choice for connecting a source device to a display placed across a room or mounted on a distant wall.
